title: TextData — Agent Design and Orchestration Database
description: A database of papers, repositories, specifications and reusable components for agent design and orchestration.
scope: 34 entries organized into seven categories. Entries describe mechanisms, supporting evidence, limitations and possible uses in TextData. Inclusion does not imply endorsement or evaluated TextData performance.
attribution: Original authors and maintainers are credited through each entry and its linked references.

families.name: Action and planning
families.question: How should an agent choose, execute and revise its next step?

families.name: Orchestration and reuse
families.question: Which responsibilities belong in program structure, and which in a model decision?

families.name: State and context
families.question: What must persist, and what does the model need to see now?

families.name: Tools and skills
families.question: How should capabilities and methodological instructions be exposed?

families.name: Delegation and handoff
families.question: When does dividing work help, and what must pass between workers?

families.name: Evaluation and adaptation
families.question: How will we assess a change without confusing extra computation with better design?

families.name: Evidence and authority
families.question: How can we recover the basis of a claim and keep source content within its proper role?
